rawConfiguration.text:
## Overview & Instance Health
At-a-glance status of the MySQL instance selected via the endpoint variable above.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.uptime`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.uptime' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}}
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.threads`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.threads' AND kind = 'connected' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}}
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.threads`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.threads' AND kind = 'running' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}}
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`mysql.query.count`), 1 minute) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.query.count' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}}
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.query.slow.count`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.query.slow.count' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}}
FROM Metric SELECT sum(`mysql.buffer_pool.usage`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.buffer_pool.usage' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}}
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.threads`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.threads' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}} FACET kind TIMESERIES
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.connection.errors`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.connection.errors' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}} FACET error TIMESERIES
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.max_used_connections`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.max_used_connections' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}}

widgets.title: X-Protocol connections (expected empty — X-Plugin not in use)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.mysqlx_connections`) AS 'Connections' WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.mysqlx_connections' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}} FACET status
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.commands`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.commands' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}} FACET command

widgets.title: Query count vs. client-issued query count

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`mysql.query.count`), 1 minute) AS 'Total queries/min', rate(sum(`mysql.query.client.count`), 1 minute) AS 'Client queries/min' WHERE (`metricName` = 'mysql.query.count' OR `metricName` = 'mysql.query.client.count') AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}} TIMESERIES
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.handlers`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.handlers' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}} FACET kind
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.joins`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.joins' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}} FACET kind
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.sorts`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.sorts' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}} FACET kind
FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.prepared_statements`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.prepared_statements' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}} FACET command

rawConfiguration.text:
### Replication Health
Only populated if this instance is configured as a replica — expected empty in this test lab (both instances are standalone).

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT latest(`mysql.replica.sql_delay`) WHERE `metricName` = 'mysql.replica.sql_delay' AND `mysql.instance.endpoint` = {{endpoint}}
